cards.back: The set professional works are 'Within Her Eyes' by James Cousins, 'Artificial Things' by Lucy Bennett and 'Emancipation of Expressionism' by Kenrick H2O Sandy

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview
cards.back: Each work has a distinct choreographic intention, style and set of features that must be understood in detail

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview
cards.back: James Cousins created 'Within Her Eyes' as a duet exploring love, loss and memory

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview
cards.back: Lucy Bennett created 'Artificial Things' for Stopgap Dance Company, featuring integrated disabled and non-disabled dancers

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview
cards.back: Kenrick H2O Sandy choreographed 'Emancipation of Expressionism' for Boy Blue Entertainment, blending hip-hop with contemporary influences

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview

cards.front: Recall a key point about Professional Dance Works Overview
cards.back: AQA expects detailed, specific knowledge — vague general answers about professional works score poorly

cards.front: What should you know about gcse dance exam tips — professional dance works overview?
cards.back: 1. For Professional Dance Works Overview questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Professional Dance Works Overview 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
